> That's not easy to answer. It'll add overhead to both our code and the middleware usage with conditional requirements. We have the same problem with the widget definition where nothing is required, but you still have to provide either `init` or `render`. You can't type-check that. That's why I don't think that this PR is necessary personally.

This PR adds `noop` upfront, so I don't see it as an overhead. We can show a warning message if it's an empty object. And if we want, we can do it like [this](https://www.typescriptlang.org/play?#-g4AQYgcE4KFQdktk8qLQGDori5RFN6MdGJ4Yf8oMZEclkWF1pE0eD4ljzq8nNd8QwiSTfmSEJSQbSwe1GXRzn06oMROzCSSubDpACboEkSiBfShQUmTi3vtLBzPAAaOwObVsgnHQ3VYgcfr1IZSzlAA), although it's not the cleanest.
